marker.description: Green-headed pin pointing to the lateral aspect of the skull base

structure: Petrous part of the temporal bone
main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the pin.
main_answer: Petrous part of the temporal bone
main_explanation: The pin indicates the pyramidal, dense bone of the temporal bone that houses the organs of hearing and balance.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures is located within the petrous part of the temporal bone?
supporting_question.explanation: The petrous part of the temporal bone contains the bony labyrinth and the tympanic cavity, which houses the ossicles (malleus, incus, and stapes).
